auth.brandPoint3: Administrators are isolated from ordinary users

users.enableDescription: After enabling, {{email}} can sign in again.

agentCommon.noOrganizations: You do not administer any organization yet.

agentOrganizations.title: Organizations
agentOrganizations.description: Manage departments, explicit memberships and administrator scopes.
agentOrganizations.createDescription: Platform administrators create organizations; organization scopes are granted separately.
agentOrganizations.unitsDescription: Departments have no hierarchy and grants do not inherit through them.
agentOrganizations.membershipsDescription: Users must be explicit members; a user belongs to at most one department per organization.
agentOrganizations.scopesDescription: Scopes are independent from memberships and are never inherited from platform admin status.

agentRuntimes.title: Runtime connections
agentRuntimes.description: Built-in sandbox runtimes are read-only; external A2A runtimes are registered per organization.
agentRuntimes.listDescription: Agents bind a runtime at creation; the binding cannot be changed afterwards.
agentRuntimes.createDescription: The service reads the Agent Card on registration; credentials stay in environment variables and only the alias is stored.

agentAgents.title: Business agents
agentAgents.description: Define agents, access rules, Auto entry policies and delegation policies.
agentAgents.listDescription: Select an agent to manage its descriptor and governance policies.
agentAgents.createDescription: The runtime is bound at creation and frozen into every run snapshot.
agentAgents.runtimeHint: Only ready runtimes can be bound.
agentAgents.detailDescription: Organization members are required; allow rules union and user deny wins.
